# EIT Climate KIC Slovenija HUB

> > A comprehensive Slovenian climate innovation hub providing practical guidance and tools for citizens and communities to build climate resilience through sustainable living practices and collective action.

EIT Climate KIC Slovenija HUB is the Slovenian branch of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology's Climate Knowledge and Innovation Community, offering evidence-based resources for climate adaptation, energy efficiency, sustainable consumption, and community resilience. The platform combines citizen guides, interactive tools, and educational content to empower individuals and communities in climate action.

## Key Topics

- Climate Resilience
- Climate Adaptation
- Energy Efficiency
- Community Resilience
- Sustainable Living
- Sustainable Consumption
- Water Conservation
- Disaster Preparedness
- Home Adaptation
- Sustainable Mobility
- Citizen Science
- Community Engagement
- Climate Action
- Environmental Sustainability

## Climate Resilience Hub

- [EIT Climate KIC Slovenija HUB](https://www.climatehub.si): EIT Climate KIC Slovenija HUB homepage introducing climate innovation initiatives
- [Climate Resilience](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience): Main climate resilience hub covering adaptation, energy efficiency, and community
- [Climate Resilience Tool For Communities](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-tool-for-communities): Interactive community tool for assessing and building climate resilience

## Home & Housing Adaptation

- [Climate Resilience For Citizens](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens): Comprehensive citizen guide for climate resilience and sustainable living practices
- [Adapting Homes For Climate Resilience](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/adapting-homes-for-climate-resilience): Guide to home adaptation for climate resilience including energy and water conservation
- [Enhancing Climate Resilience Through Energy Efficiency In Housing](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/adapting-homes-for-climate-resilience/enhancing-climate-resilience-through-energy-efficiency-in-housing): Tutorial on energy efficiency improvements for climate-resilient housing
- [Enhancing Climate Resilience Through Water Conservation](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/adapting-homes-for-climate-resilience/enhancing-climate-resilience-through-water-conservation): How-to guide for water conservation practices in homes for climate adaptation
- [Enhancing Climate Resilience Through Climate Adaptation In The Garden](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/adapting-homes-for-climate-resilience/enhancing-climate-resilience-through-climate-adaptation-in-the-garden): Guide to garden climate adaptation for resilient and sustainable home environments
- [Enhancing Climate Resilience Through Disaster Preparedness](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/adapting-homes-for-climate-resilience/enhancing-climate-resilience-through-disaster-preparedness): Home disaster preparedness guide for climate-resilient emergency readiness

## Sustainable Consumption & Lifestyle

- [Adopting Sustainable Consumption Practices](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/adopting-sustainable-consumption-practices): Guide to sustainable consumption practices for climate adaptation and resilience
- [Sustainable Food Consumption](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/adopting-sustainable-consumption-practices/sustainable-food-consumption): How-to guide for sustainable food consumption and climate-resilient food systems
- [Sustainable Mobility](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/adopting-sustainable-consumption-practices/sustinable-mobility): Guide to sustainable mobility and transportation choices for climate action
- [Consumption And Waste Reduction](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/adopting-sustainable-consumption-practices/consumption-and-waste-reduction): Guide to waste reduction and circular economy practices for sustainable living

## Community Resilience & Engagement

- [Building A Resilient Community](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/building-a-resilient-community): Guide to building community resilience through climate adaptation and engagement
- [Community Resilience](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/building-a-resilient-community/community-resilience): Comprehensive guide to community resilience covering adaptation and sustainability
- [Social Connections](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/building-a-resilient-community/social-connections): Guide to building social connections for community resilience and climate action
- [Community Engagement](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-for-citizens/building-a-resilient-community/community-engagement): How-to guide for community engagement in climate resilience and local action

## Citizen Science & Tools

- [Citizen Science Approach](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/citizen-science-approach): Guide to citizen science approaches for climate adaptation and community engagement
- [Step 1 – Preparation](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-tool-for-communities/step-1-preparation): Step 1 of climate resilience tool: preparation phase for community implementation
- [Step 2 – Risk Assessment](https://www.climatehub.si/climate-resilience/climate-resilience-tool-for-communities/step-2-risk-assessment): Step 2 of climate resilience tool: risk assessment for community adaptation
